admission.justification: The scroll-owner contract spans the cockpit main, review grid, reading column and content-sized panes; the former narrow clipping made long review content unreachable even with zero horizontal document overflow. Reassessed at the L201 fifth freeze (head d59c3493): the guarded_by_test criterion is dropped because the proofs that named it were removed with the tests they cited, which are gone at the candidate; the criteria kept are the ones the tree still satisfies.

applicability: Scroll ownership and reachable reading content on the review page across its desktop and stacked layouts.
conditions: Above40rem the root does not scroll, the tree uses exactly one inner CSS-height scroller with overscroll containment, and reading content scrolls in its column under a sticky head.

At40rem and narrower the tree stacks above reading content and ReviewMain provides the vertical scroll owner; the reading column is overflow-visible vertically and clips horizontally without becoming another scroller.
Content-sized review diffs and statement/guarantee panes use fit, with no own max-height scrollbox.
Local row reveal changes tree scrollTop rather than inline tree heights; controls and pinned rows retain their own layout.
exclusions: The chat frame, tray list and Explanation frame, which keep their own admitted scroll owners.
Fresh browser wheel/touch geometry acceptance by this helper.
The separate selected-line1px rule and its D417 evaluation disposition.
